name: LuSaathi Heat Advisor
description: Answers outdoor workers in India (EN/HI/Hinglish/Marathi) whether it is safe to work at a place and hour, using a forecast-based WBGT heat-stress estimate. Never overrides IMD/NDMA/State heat-action-plan alerts.
notes: Agent Studio scaffold by AgentFoundry; tools wired by Tali Builder (AI agent). Kit field dropped by IDE save — stubs originally targeted claude-agent-sdk-ts; paid SDK scaffold removed. Tools are dependency-free .mjs wrappers over lib/*.js.
